nodes.label: Demo selector
nodes.notes: React accepts one of six synthetic app-user IDs. Backend SyntheticSubjects creates immutable app-user context, not an authenticated application identity.

nodes.label: Live query planner
nodes.notes: Live IQ GetSemanticModelSchema returns real metadata under a separate delegated Entra user; exact delegated IQ permission grants are unspecified. Only MetadataTool is allowed under IQ; native ExecuteQuery and ValueSearch are not used. GPT-5.4 Responses generates DAX in a separate store:false call.

nodes.label: QueryBroker
nodes.notes: .NET QueryBroker authenticates using a certificate service principal. QuerySP has workspaceAdmin for role selection. The broker attaches the ExternalAppScope role and trusted app-user customData outside generated DAX, calls the newer executeDaxQueries endpoint, and decodes Arrow/LZ4 results. The endpoint can return HTTP 200 error rowsets.
